interface.shortDescription: Shared file-based memory for Codex and Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Release v0.44.0 adds optional authored record-preservation probes and enforces configured source-span revocations at two context consumers: Jev file-grounded judgments and Jarvis generation. A unique literal anchor selects one line or paragraph from a hash-bound source; the whole normalized record is compared, with no semantic truth or edit-authority claim. Omitting relation probes preserves the existing checks. Revocation filtering runs on full raw UTF-8 source text before display normalization or truncation, and the same source/configuration envelope is checked around dispatch; no memory_revocation_file keeps the existing behavior. Scope is the two implemented consumers and explicitly declared derivatives, not all external programs or automatic discovery of semantic copies. Already-sent data cannot be withdrawn. Checkout-only paired synthetic fixtures and development-only Hypothesis lifecycle extensions report scoped observations and a simulated sink, not a persistent outbox, model efficacy or real-world safety. Conversation-budget research remains exploratory; this release introduces no optimized budget or streaming redesign. Python 3.10+ standard-library runtime, default hook bindings and the configuration template remain unchanged. Native discovery checks enabled skills and required installed resource bytes, not semantic correctness. Publication does not upgrade active installations or company vaults. Exact-source tests, CI, installed-byte checks, certificate replay and release-asset verification are separate final gates; no historical success count is inherited. Hashes bind bytes and observations, not identity, authority or truth. For older transitions where checker_sha256 changes: if warnings were promoted to fatal, revert them to warning, bring the Claude Code and Codex installations and a git vault's 00-meta/scripts engine copy to the same version (also when rolling back), regenerate the certificate there, then promote again.
